decisions.reason: The source permits reordering the power connector pins discussed in message 138; it does not change the separate J_PWR_SIGNAL connector or its signal pinout.
Power-connector pin ordering does not alter I2C cable length, bus speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
The source concerns the power connector's 5V and 3.3V positions and does not change the USB D+ or D- data-line requirement.
Permission to choose power-connector pin order for layout convenience does not change any current board dimensions, orientation, mounting, clearance, spacing, or connector-placement constraint.
The decision applies to the interboard power connector, not the separate JST-PH battery connector or its GND, VCC, and NTC functions.
Power-connector pin ordering does not change the four-layer stack or dedicated ground-plane strategy.
Matching the main-board power connector does not alter the SK6812 charge-status indication path or the decision not to use a separate charge LED.
The interboard power pin-order decision does not change battery overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal-protection behavior.
The source does not change the requirement for TVS ESD protection.
Reordering the interboard power connector pins does not change the switched 5V rail's enable control, default state, converter, or sensor-power behavior.
The source changes allowable pin ordering but does not select a new connector or alter any component sourceability policy.
The connector pin-order flexibility leaves the three-board system architecture unchanged.
